description: Default Renovate preset for dixneuf19 repos

packageRules.description: Group non-major GitHub Actions bumps into one PR
The docker/* actions move their Node runtime together, so their majors land as one PR
Group Python linters, formatters and test tooling; majors still get their own group PR
One PR moves the Python runtime everywhere it is declared: Docker base image, .python-version, requires-python, setup-python
Python minor/major runtime bumps need manual review. Patch and digest bumps still automerge

Per semver a 0.x minor may break anything, but getUpdateType() is positional so Renovate calls it a minor and :automergeMinor would land it unreviewed. Matched by regex rather than "<1.0.0": the range form goes through versioningApi.matches(), which the docker versioning module (used by every oci:// Helm chart) implements as plain equality, so it silently never matches

The docker datasource only reports a release timestamp for Docker Hub, so on every other registry the timestamp-required default leaves updates pending forever (renovate#37196, renovate#38656, renovate#39064). This also covers oci:// Helm charts, which resolve through the docker datasource
A pin freezes what the reference already resolves to and brings in no new code, so a cooldown only prolongs the unpinned state (Renovate docs, minimum-release-age.md#pindigest-updates)
:automergeDigest only covers digest refreshes; also automerge the initial pin

Lock file maintenance has no timestamp, so timestamp-required leaves it pending forever. The 3-day value is kept because Renovate forwards it to npm (--before) and Poetry (POETRY_SOLVER_MIN_RELEASE_AGE); uv repos enforce it through [tool.uv] exclude-newer

Actions are pinned to a full semver tag, so a digest change without a version change means the tag was force-pushed (the tj-actions/changed-files attack). github-tags ages it against the original release date, so the cooldown cannot catch it: review by hand

logLevelRemap.matchMessage: /did not have a releaseTimestamp, but as we're running with minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-optional, proceeding/
